description: Terminal display review corpus for PairOfCleats search. Focuses on human-facing rendering, help/error surfaces, explain/stats output, and machine-output contrast cases.

featureSets.title: CLI help and errors
featureSets.description: Observe help, version, and request-error output.

featureSets.title: Human result layouts
featureSets.description: Covers default mixed output, code, prose, extracted prose, empty states, and filter-driven views.

featureSets.title: Explain and stats
featureSets.description: Exercises metadata-heavy result rendering and diagnostics footer paths.

featureSets.title: Machine output contrast
featureSets.description: Contrast human output with JSON and compact JSON payloads.

cases.title: Search help surface
cases.why: Exercises the full help screen layout at each terminal size.

cases.title: Search version output
cases.why: Tiny but useful for observing minimal output styling and spacing.

cases.title: Invalid mode request
cases.why: Exercises typed request-error presentation.

cases.title: Removed flag request
cases.why: Shows removed-flag guidance in the terminal surface.

cases.title: Default mixed-surface results
cases.why: Broad mixed result set that typically produces code, comments, and prose sections.

cases.title: Code-rich symbol results
cases.why: High-signal code result with signature and metadata.

cases.title: Prose heading results
cases.why: Strong prose anchor for excerpt rendering.

cases.title: Extracted prose comment results
cases.why: Exercises comment/extracted-prose rendering.

cases.title: Records positive-hit output
cases.why: Provides a stable positive records hit for terminal review coverage.

cases.title: Empty-state output
cases.why: Exercises the no-results state cleanly.

cases.title: Human stats footer
cases.why: Exercises stats emission in human mode.

cases.title: Human explain rendering
cases.why: Exercises score-breakdown-heavy result rendering.

cases.title: Human explain full rendering
cases.why: Shows the full explain tier with deeper relation and dataflow sections.

cases.title: Human explain prose rendering
cases.why: Shows explain output on prose results.

cases.title: Matched-token annotations
cases.why: Exercises matched-token annotations in human output.

cases.title: Case-sensitive docs query
cases.why: Exercises human display for case-sensitive prose searches.

cases.title: Import-filtered source result
cases.why: Useful for import-heavy code result rendering.

cases.title: Regex path-filtered fixture result
cases.why: Exercises file-filtered human output on a stable fixture.

cases.title: Async-filtered fixture result
cases.why: Exercises async function display against a compact fixture.

cases.title: Generator-filtered fixture result
cases.why: Exercises generator result rendering against a compact fixture.

cases.title: Compact JSON contrast
cases.why: Contrasts the human surface with compact JSON output.

cases.title: Explain + stats JSON contrast
cases.why: Captures the heaviest machine-output shape for comparison.
